exposure: Blastocyst biopsy for preimplantation genetic testing (PGT)
cohort: The study included 1,008 women aged ≤ 35 years who underwent ICSI cycles and single frozen embryo transfer, resulting in a live singleton newborn.
finding: Blastocyst biopsy was not associated with increased risks of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy or other unfavorable maternal and neonatal outcomes, though an increased percentage of female gender was observed in the PGT group.
followup_time: Short-term perspective (during pregnancy and immediately after birth)
